entries.note: The order is placed and the parcel waits for one of the firm's shops in Japan to take it in.
A shop in Japan took the parcel in: the first row in the firm's hands.
The parcel waits at the shop for the firm's warehouse to collect it.
The firm's warehouse in Japan took the parcel in.

entries.wording: […][中通国际]进行处理…订单已操作入库
entries.note: ZTO International's row: the parcel entered its warehouse in the city in brackets. The colon is full-width or not.

entries.wording: […][中通国际]进行处理…订单已操作出库
entries.note: ZTO International's row: the parcel left its warehouse for the airport.
The parcel reached the bonded warehouse at the airport named, for export.

entries.wording: 清关完成等待航班装载
entries.note: Export clearance in Japan is done and the parcel waits to be loaded on a flight.
ZTO International's row: the flight left the country and airport in brackets.
ZTO International's row: the flight landed in China.

entries.wording: 快件转运中，请耐心等候
entries.note: The parcel moves on from the airport in China to customs.
ZTO International's row: import clearance in China has begun.
ZTO's branch named in brackets took the cleared parcel for the domestic leg; its courier and phone are left out. The firm had it long before, so it moves on rather than being accepted.

entries.wording: 快件离开[…]发往[…]，网点发件扫描
entries.note: ZTO's row: the parcel left one site for the next.

entries.wording: 快件到达[…]，网点到件扫描
entries.note: ZTO's row: the parcel reached the site in brackets.
ZTO's courier from the branch in brackets is delivering; their name, phone and the rest of the sentence are left out.
ZTO left the parcel at a pickup point or locker for the recipient; the point's name and its phone are left out.
ZTO's row: signed for, here with the pickup code; the phones after it are left out.
ZTO's closing row from the branch in brackets; the signer and the courtesy after it are left out.
